part.text:
Fixed. The issue was that clap's `overrides_with` made `--plain` and `--paging` silently cancel each other, so `--paging=never --plain` dropped the paging arg (falling back to auto-paging). Changes, mirroring the upstream fix for sharkdp/bat#2731/#3108:

- `src/bin/bat/clap_app.rs`: removed `.overrides_with("paging")` from the `plain` arg and `.overrides_with("plain")` from the `paging` arg, so both flags are now always visible.
- `src/bin/bat/app.rs`: computes whether the last `-p` occurrence came after `--paging` (`indices_of` comparison).
- `src/config.rs`: `resolve_output_layout` takes this ordering; `--paging=always` now degrades to `PagingMode::Never` only when `-pp` follows it, and `Some("never")` now returns `PagingMode::Never` explicitly instead of the config default.

Verified in the testbed container: all 9 paging integration tests (including the previously failing `paging_does_not_override_simple_plain` and `simple_plain_does_not_override_paging`) and the full suite (74 lib + 154 integration + others) pass.
